provisioner.invocation_boundary: nix flake lock 'path:/home/an/NAS-setup/uos' -- the bare 'nix flake lock' fails with libgit2 error 6 because an EMPTY stray directory /home/an/NAS-setup/uos/.git makes Nix classify the tree as a Git flake. UOS is standalone non-colocated Jujutsu; that directory contains no Git repository and drives no VCS behaviour, but flake commands must use the explicit path: URL until it is removed.

policy.honest_boundary: Nix-provided binaries live in /nix/store by construction: their RPATHs and ELF interpreter paths are absolute store paths, so they CANNOT be relocated under toolchains/ and still execute. toolchains/nix-profile is a symlink farm into the store, not a copy. Any claim that the Nix binaries are physically inside the project is false.

defects_closed_in_this_pass: tools/lib/uos-toolchain.sh resolved UOS_ROOT from ${BASH_SOURCE[0]} under `set -euo pipefail`. Sourced from the operator's zsh login shell this aborted on an unset parameter, and without nounset it would have silently produced a wrong UOS_ROOT -- making uos_have() report ABSENT for installed toolchains. The library now resolves its own path under bash and zsh, and only applies `set -euo pipefail` when EXECUTED, never when sourced into an interactive shell.
